notes: Modified cash basis city. Governmental balances: statement prints fund balances (beginning 3,099,878 p6, ending 2,866,804 p4/p6) which equal governmental net position = cash + county treasurer + investments, used as beginning/ending cash. Governmental column used from Total Governmental Funds (p5). Business-type (Lottery, Water, Sewer) from proprietary statement p8: loan proceeds 936,595 recorded as debt_proceeds; capital outlay and debt service recorded as disbursements (total 1,255,857 ties to p2). Business receipts total computed since no single total printed. No interfund transfers. Detail: only the all-funds budget schedule (p9) exists; it mixes governmental and utility funds (e.g. Debt service principal 216,403 = 168,398 gov + 48,005 BT) so it cannot be assigned to a fund type and was omitted (detail empty). Note p9 actual receipts (2,550,923) and disbursements (3,579,241) combine both fund types. Balance sheet from government-wide Total column, no liabilities printed. Read pages 1-9 of 9 Proprietary Miscellaneous 16,015 split by column: Water+Sewer 10,550 utilities, Lottery 5,465 economic development (p9 community development). Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p5, p8) replace the combined schedule.
